fullName: Host · Settings (host only) [H-SET-06] Every notification category toggles off and back on @regression
description:
Host settings (Host manual ch. 16). Shares the guest settings suite; the
host-only cases (payout accounts, notification categories) are below it.

H-SET-05 (add a payout account) is never automated: it would register bank
details on the shared QA host and must not touch the default account.
